items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: Oh, we know Harry. He was raised. Yeah, Harry Shannon. You're on Little Jackson. He played a, well, a straight.

ctx.x: I think so. I don't know about him.

He used to go on the love of Paul Young Abner. And he used to play with fish sometimes, you know. Sometimes when I couldn't make it, why, he went and played with fish. You remember Harry Shannon. Harry Shannon, yeah. He was an umpore player. He was an umpore player.
What do you mean by that? He wasn't very good? He wasn't good at all.
